scope: Torch native NUTS, CPU float64, dense two-mass SNR20 zero-noise common-data self-injection for IMRPhenomD and IMRPhenomD_NRTidal; fixed remaining parameters and original native uniform priors
limitations: No physical-accuracy, independent-injection, noise-coverage, full-dimensional PE, or all-waveform qualification claim.
Initial failed runs remain separate; followup draws are neither combined with them nor selected by seed.
Neighbor probes inspect accepted states, not unarchived divergent leapfrog leaves.
Bulk chains, posterior arrays, test/support snapshots and logs remain externally retained; this JSON contains receipt scalars and file hashes.

followup_design.reason: Original finite runs failed effective-sample, MCSE and divergence gates; same reference distribution and thresholds retained. Higher acceptance targets integration stability; longer chains target sampling precision.
followup_design.change_scope: Sampler settings only. All original priors, data, chart, metric, gates, waveforms, compiled strategy and runtime remain fixed.
followup_design.maximum_additional_work: One fresh 4-chain run per model; no repeated seed selection, combining old draws, or automatic extensions.
followup_design.stop_condition: Terminal gate outcome or 30 minutes per model; preserve all failures.
